description.value:
Trigger You impose the glitching condition on a tech creature, hazard, or tech equipment with a camera.

You know how to use technological glitches and malfunctions to your advantage to disguise your presence. You become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Concealed] to the triggering creature, hazard, or creatures using the glitching tech item to perceive you as long as it has the glitching condition.

Special If you have the X-Hat Firewalker Frame lineage feat, you become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Invisible], rather than concealed.
